Interview with Lesley Gordon

Interview with Lesley Gordon

By Megan Bever | September 7, 2026 | Comments 0 Comment
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

In today’s Muster, associate editor Megan Bever interviews Lesley Gordon about her recent book, Dread Danger: Cowardice and Combat in the American Civil War (Cambridge University Press, 2024). Gordon is the Charles G. Summersell Chair of Southern History at the University of Alabama and the past president of the Society of Civil War Historians.
